verdict.rationale: Organization-level admin controls are a fair question for an AI assistant that could offer team plans, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows individual-user controls: opting out of model training, deleting indexed data from a personal "Workspace" settings page, and revoking connected accounts. Trusted People is agent-to-agent coordination with friends, not member or permission management. Nothing documents an org workspace with an admin who manages members, roles or organization-wide data policies.
